title: Integrated launch heatmap and adaptive cutline playbook for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a compact, actionable playbook and visual heatmap that ties milestone signals (service SLOs, integration readiness, docs completeness, security sign-off) to explicit scope-lock and cutline decisions across API, Console, and Runtime. This ticket coordinates cross-team owners, templates for release notes, and a short-cycle escalation matrix so product launches can adapt to late-breaking regressions without broad outages. The deliverable is a single-page heatmap PDF + a reproducible checklist that PMs/Eng/Design can use for both planned and emergency cut decisions.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Heatmap artifact created and reviewed by Eng/Design/Docs with clear color-coded action bands (Green: ship, Yellow: conditional ship w/ mitigations, Red: cut or rollback).
2) Cutline rules documented with unambiguous signals (e.g., 99th p90 latency spike > 2x baseline, regression failure rate > 0.5% on smoke tests, docs < 80% complete) and owner assignments.
3) Release notes template and timeline synced to Console and API docs repos; final notes draft generation automated via checklist.
4) Escalation and on-call contact matrix added to playbook; three dry-run scenarios executed and logged.
5) Stakeholder sign-offs recorded in comments and links to artifacts included.
tasks: Draft heatmap axes and band definitions (latency, infra readiness, feature completeness, docs)
Work with Eng to define measurable signals and readouts (dashboards/alerts) and thresholds for cut decision
Coordinate with Design to produce a single-page visual and a printer-friendly PDF
Create release notes template with sections for user impact, migration notes, rollbacks, and 'what changed' summary
Wire up a lightweight checklist in the release-train Confluence page and link to PR templates
Schedule cross-functional dry-run meetings for 3 hypothetical late regressions
Define cut/rollback automation steps and owners in the runbook
Publish final artifacts and notify stakeholders via Slack channel #release-train and email distribution list

rollout_strategy: Three-tier progressive rollout: 1) Internal canary (10% routed to non-critical orgs), 2) Gradual expand with automated SLO gating (hourly checks), 3) Full cutover if all gates green. Each tier has pre-defined fallback (automatic routing to previous model variant or region) and communication template for release notes and incident channels.
notes: This playbook is intentionally compact so that PMs can use it as a single source of truth during T-minus 48 hours and for on-call escalations. Key innovation: a compact heatmap that converts qualitative readiness into deterministic cut decisions. Follow-up ticket proposed to integrate the heatmap into the Console release workflow as an interactive panel.
